annotations.title: Match a list of records to companies

description: Match a list of up to 500 records (name, optional county, domain or CUI) to Romanian companies: each row gets match {cui, companyName, confidence, matchedOn} and the record, or no_match with up to 3 candidates. A valid CUI wins (confidence 1.0). Each row is one lookup; rows past today's allowance come back not_processed (partial: true, remaining: rows to resend after the reset).

MatchRow.description: One record to match: any of name, county, domain, cui; ref (your own id) is echoed back.

county.description: Optional county hint (diacritic-insensitive): companies there rank higher.
county.title: County

cui.description: Optional CUI (tax code); a valid one wins (confidence 1.0).
cui.title: Cui

domain.description: Optional website domain ('dedeman.ro'), matched to the registry's website field.
domain.title: Domain

ref.description: Your own id for the row, echoed back unchanged.
ref.title: Ref

MatchRow.title: MatchRow

compact.description: Optional: true keeps a short preset per row (name, CUI, county, city, legal form, risk level and what it did not check, phone, website, latest revenue and headcount, record url).
compact.title: Compact

fields.description: Optional: keep only these company fields in each row, comma-separated (companyName,cui,county,risk; dotted paths such as risk.level work). Without it the full record is returned.
fields.title: Fields

rows.description: Up to 500 records, each {name, county, domain, cui, ref} (any of them; ref is your own id, echoed back), or a bare string (a CUI, a domain or a name).
rows.title: Rows

name: match_companies

outputSchema.description: One match per input record, in input order.

asOf.description: What to cite: registry (ONRC snapshot date), financialYear (fiscal year of the figures), anaf (day of the ANAF data), snapshot, published, source.

attribution.description: The credit line to keep when redistributing the data (CC BY 4.0).

dailyLimit.description: When partial: the daily-limit notice in the refusal vocabulary (error daily_limit_reached, message, limit, used, remaining allowance, resets_at, requested, processed, plan, get_a_key, pricing, docs, upgrade with a key).

error.description: Set only when there is no answer (empty_query, invalid_cui, data_unavailable, plan_required ...); such a call is not counted.

errors.description: Rows that are input errors (nothing to match on).

fields.description: The company fields kept when fields or compact trimmed the rows.

metering.description: What the batch cost: rows, counted, notCounted (input-error rows and rows not processed are not counted), notProcessed (when partial) and the rule.

noMatch.description: Rows with no match above the threshold.

partial.description: true when today's allowance ran out partway: the first processed rows were answered, the rest have status not_processed (not run, not counted).

processed.description: Rows answered, from the first one (input-error rows included).

remaining.description: Rows not processed (the last ones): send them again after the reset. 0 when the whole batch ran.

results.description: Per row: row, input, status (matched or no_match), match {cui, companyName, confidence, matchedOn}, company, or candidates.

company.description: A company record: companyName, cui, registrationCode, registrationDate (DD/MM/YYYY), legalForm, euid, address (a sole trader's PFA/II/IF locality only in an answer listing several companies, with addressScope: locality), county, city, website, phone as declared (+ phoneSource: ANAF, declared by the taxpayer; phoneStatus: valid, corrected with phoneSuggestion, or unverified: check before calling), caenActivities [{code, activity (RO), activityEn}], directors, representatives [{name, role}], status [{code, name}], latestFinancials {year, revenue, netResult, employees; RON}, anaf {mainCaen, vatPayer, eFactura, inactive}, risk {level, label, reasons, isLead}, source, asOf, url (the company's public record page to share with the user; null for sole traders and other natural persons), and score/match on name searches. With fields or compact, only the requested keys (compact keeps url).

input.description: The row as read: name, county, domain, cui, ref.

match.description: The company matched: cui, companyName, confidence, matchedOn.

ref.description: Your own id for the row, echoed back.

row.description: Position of the row in the input (0-based).

status.description: matched, no_match, error, or not_processed (reason daily_limit_reached: not run, not counted).

source.description: Data source: onrc (registry) or mfp (Ministry of Finance filings).

threshold.description: Confidence a row needs to be matched (0-1).

warnings.description: Notes on how the request was read (a clamped limit, a widened CAEN code, an ignored field).

title: Match a list of records to companies
